content: Hi! How can I help you? Need help with class notes or sharing files today?
Hey! I'm trying to get the Chemistry lecture PDFs from last week, but I'm not sure which link to use.

Absolutely, happy to help. I've just updated the shared folder, here's the link: <chem_notes_link>. You can browse through each lecture by date, and I've marked the ones with detailed diagrams for quick reference.
Thanks! When I try to open Lecture 5, it says I need permission. Am I missing something?
Oops, thanks for catching that! I've fixed the permissions on Lecture 5, try clicking the link again. If it still doesn't work, let me know and I'll send a fresh link.
It works now! Should I just view them online, or is it better to download?

Great! For quick reference, viewing online is perfect, but for adding notes or offline study, I recommend downloading the PDFs. You can select multiple files and download them as a ZIP for easier organizing.
That's helpful. Are the answer keys in the same folder?
Yes! I created an 'Extras' subfolder in <chem_notes_link>, the answer keys are there with clear labels. Feel free to browse and let me know if anything's missing.
Is it okay to share these with my study group?
Of course, just please remind everyone not to reshare outside the class for privacy. And if you add your own notes, you can upload them right into the shared folder so the group can benefit too.
Perfect, thanks! I'll start downloading now and let you know if I run into trouble.
You're very welcome! If you have upload issues or hit any storage limits, just let me know, I can help organize or troubleshoot. Enjoy studying, and happy to see the group working together!
